meta.name: web3-testing
meta.description: Test smart contracts comprehensively using Hardhat and Foundry with unit tests, integration tests, and mainnet forking. Use when testing Solidity contracts, setting up blockchain test suites, or validating DeFi protocols.

copy.tagline: 用主网分叉全面测试智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在发布去中心化金融协议前需要全面检查合约行为
copy.tagline_en: Test smart contracts thoroughly with mainnet forking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build DeFi protocols and need automated contract tests before launch.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你项目选 Hardhat 或 Foundry,产出 Solidity 合约的测试代码、配置文件与运行建议,覆盖单元测试、Gas 优化、模糊测试、主网分叉等场景。
howto.when: 当你说要测试 Solidity 合约、搭建区块链测试套件或验证 DeFi 协议时;提到单元测试、Gas 优化、模糊测试等具体需求也会触发。

say.text: 给我用 Hardhat 写一个 Token 合约的单元测试,包含转账和余额检查。
say.note: 生成测试代码并说明如何运行。

say.text: 用 Foundry 对 transfer 做模糊测试,边界条件也测一下。
say.note: 会生成 fuzz 测试用例。

say.text: 把主网 Uniswap 合约 fork 下来,测一下 DAI 兑换。
say.note: 会给出主网分叉测试脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will write Solidity contract tests based on Hardhat or Foundry, including config files and run instructions. It covers unit tests, gas checks, fuzzing, mainnet forking, snapshots, and account impersonation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to test Solidity contracts, set up a blockchain test suite, or validate DeFi protocols; also for requests about unit tests, gas optimization, fuzzing, or mainnet forking.

say_en.text: Write a Token contract unit test in Hardhat covering transfers and balance checks.
say_en.note: It will produce test code and run instructions.

say_en.text: Use Foundry to fuzz transfer with edge-case amounts.
say_en.note: It will generate fuzz test cases.

say_en.text: Fork mainnet and test a DAI swap on Uniswap.
say_en.note: It will provide a fork test script.
